newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MMI appoints FAI's Maciver as Asia manager.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MMI appoints FAI's Maciver as Asia manager.

text.p: Insurer MMI Ltd said on Tuesday it has appointed former FAI Insurances Ltd executive director Angust Maciver as general manager of its international operations.

The company, which is controlled by German insurance group Allianz AG with a 38 percent stake, said Maciver will be responsible for the development of MMI's operations in Asia, the inwards insurance business to be located in Singapore, and MMI's New Zealand operation.
Maciver, who had been with FAI since 1974, will begin at MMI in February next year. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
